rituals.title: ENDOWMENT FLIP
rituals.mission: Give the same object two ownership states and compare value.
rituals.rule: The object itself cannot improve or worsen.
rituals.play: Imagine a plain mug is already yours: what minimum price would make you give it up? Reset and imagine it belongs to someone else: what maximum price would you pay for it?
rituals.twist: Keep the mug identical in both rounds.
rituals.win: Ownership alone can shift the value assigned to an unchanged object.
rituals.mind_bend: The same neutral mug can feel more valuable when imagined as already owned than when imagined as something to buy, exposing ownership as a valuation bias.
